messages:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing a spike of fncall validation rejects in prod EU for the last 3.5h, customers are getting 400s from structured toolhook validation.
raj: Link to the quick metric?
metrics-bot: alert: fncall.validation.rejects rate = 5.2x baseline (04:12 window) — top route: /generate/chat, top model: rwd-neo-3.
sam: I believe this aligns with the strict-validator rollout v2.1 at ~1799989200.
maria: yes. strict-validator replaced permissive parsing. This exposed a bunch of third-party tool adapters that return arrays instead of objects.
anna: Oof. Support is getting tickets. We need a short mitigation to avoid customer-facing errors while we triage.
theo: There's a permissive fallback already (coerce-arrays-to-objects) but it's disabled for strict routes because of billing/route-attrib concerns.
raj: If we enable fallback blindly we'll mess up quota attribution and billing dash graphs — it'll look like success but cost will still be full fncall.
maria: Agreed but customers prefer degraded output over a 400. Can we route failed fncalls to fallback and tag them with reject_reason=fallback_taken so dashboards distinguish them?
sam: +1. Also we should sample the original payloads (sanitized) for those rejects so the adapters can be fixed.
anna: Console UX note: Ops can't currently filter by reject_reason or see sampled payloads inline — they need to jump to logs. That slows triage.
raj: Proposal: add a telemetry label `reject_reason` + `validator_version` + `fallback_taken` to invocation metrics, and expose a console filter for `reject=soft` vs `reject=strict`.
theo: Also emit a trace event with (route_id, model_variant, validator_version, reject_reason, fallback_taken, original_checksum) so we can correlate replays without storing raw PII.
anna: For the dashboard: quick query we need is: 
```
SELECT count(*) as rejects, reject_reason
FROM invokes
WHERE env='prod' AND region='eu-west-1' AND ts >= now()-6h
GROUP BY reject_reason
```
We should add that as a canned card on the invoke health dashboard.
metrics-bot: note: creating sample stream job requires opt-in due to retention policy.
raj: Implementation plan: (1) enable permissive fallback for a small slice (10%) by route, (2) emit telemetry tags and trace event, (3) add dashboard card + console filter, (4) increase slice if stable.
maria: Customer impact mitigation ok. Sam — coordinate with support and enable config. Anna — can you add the UI mock for the filter + sample viewer?
sam: @support will draft a one-line customer-facing note: "temporary fallback enabled to reduce schema errors; no change to cost or quota yet". I'll hold on sending until we flip the slice.
anna: I'll sketch up UI this afternoon and post Figma link. Should be small: a toggle per route -> {soft fallback: on/off, sample retention: 24/72h, show last 10 samples}.
theo: Small callout: when fallback is taken we must record `billing_class` explicitly (fncall_success_via_fallback) so billing pipeline can tag it differently later if needed.
raj: I'll open an eng ticket and attach the SQL/card mock. Planning to PR the telemetry tags + sample exporter. Assigning to me for the backend.
maria: Assign to raj. Theo — can you add trace schema to observability spec?
theo: Yep, will add a minimal proto and doc.
metrics-bot: alert: rejects reduced to 1.4x baseline after enabling 10% fallback slice (10m).
maria: Nice. Keeps customers working while we push the longer-term dashboard + Billing tags. Next steps: raj backend PR, anna UI mock, theo trace schema, sam support comms.
sam: Will follow up with support thread and mark any escalations.
anna: Figma: https://figma.com/s/console-soft-fallback-mock (draft).
raj: PR opened: https://git.rewd/rw/telemetry/pull/234 — telemetry + sample exporter, WIP.
maria: Thanks team. Let's reconvene in 2h for status.
